sections.overview:
Agent37-Skills-Collection provides Claude Code plugins that enhance productivity through targeted AI capabilities. The YC-Advisor plugin delivers startup advice from 434 curated resources including Paul Graham essays and founder interviews, automatically triggered when discussing startups or fundraising. The Local-Review command analyzes uncommitted code changes for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues before committing. Developers and founders can install these skills to streamline workflows and improve code quality.
Automating repetitive tasks
Enhancing customer interactions
Streamlining data analysis
Improving sales outreach
sections.usage:
```
Using the agent37-skills-collection, help me analyze [COMPANY]'s financial data from Productiv. Identify trends in [SPECIFIC_METRIC] over the past [TIME_PERIOD]. Provide actionable insights and recommendations for optimization. Focus on [SPECIFIC_AREA] such as budget forecasting or expense tracking.
```
